title: Materials
summary: Principled BSDF materials: porcelain (white, roughness 0.35) shared by mug and plate, a shiny cream donut material shared by both donuts with subsurface scattering, glossy semi-transparent sugar, a rough toasted croissant with subsurface, and a picnic tablecloth plane with a brick-texture check pattern and a magic-texture bump.
expected_result: White porcelain mug and plate, golden sugared donuts, a brown croissant, on a blue and white check tablecloth.

steps.note: new material 'Porcelana': white, not metallic, roughness halfway (blurred reflections)
donut: a cream colour, shiny (it is oily), soft: subsurface 0.5
the second donut: the same material (Ctrl+L)
sugar crystals: white, very glossy, half transparent (alpha)
tablecloth: brick texture, frequency 1, width and height 0.5 (squares), thin vibrant blue lines, white squares; bump from a magic texture (scale 200, distortion 15): fabric
